days.title: Northern Canyons and Highlands
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Jökulsárgljúfur
stops.detail: Long ago, massive glacial floods cut the Jökulsárgljúfur canyon into the northern part of this plateau.

stops.name: Dettifoss
stops.detail: The mighty Dettifoss waterfall still thunders into the upper end of this gorge, while the picturesque landscapes at Hljóðaklettar and the horseshoe-shaped cliffs of Ásbyrgi can be found further north.

stops.name: Ásbyrgi
stops.detail: A visitor center and a campsite can be found in Ásbyrgi, another campsite is at Vesturdalur.

days.title: Southern Peaks and Oases
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Skaftafell
stops.detail: Protected by the high ice masses, the vegetated oasis of Skaftafell overlooks the black sands deposited west of the river Skeiðará.

stops.name: Hvannadalshnjúkur
stops.detail: The southernmost part of the glacier covers the central volcano Öræfajökull and Iceland's highest mountain peak, Hvannadalshnjúkur.

stops.name: Morsárfoss
stops.detail: In the south of Vatnajökull National Park is Morsárfoss, the highest waterfall in Iceland.

days.title: Volcanic West and Eastern Mountains
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Askja
stops.detail: The volcanoes Askja, Kverkfjöll and Snæfell dominate this area, as does the volcanic table mountain Herðubreið.

stops.name: Kverkfjöll
stops.detail: The eastern area includes the Kverkfjöll mountains and the northeastern part of Vatnajökull as well as the foothills of Snæfellsöræfi.

stops.name: Langisjór
stops.detail: The western area extends through the southwestern part of Vatnajökull and vast areas outside the glacier, including the Lakagígar craters and Langisjór.
